version.description: Canonical semver (no leading zeros); the same pattern is enforced by scripts/lib/policy_validate.jq.

require_signed.description: Require signed journal entries. Per-environment lookup: deployment_requirements.<env>.require_signed, then deployment_requirements.default.require_signed, then this field.

allow_ssh_signers_file.description: Allowed signers file; relative paths resolve from the repository root. Beats gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile, which is only a fallback.

require_ticket.description: Roadmap: validated but not yet enforced (see #79).

require_service.description: Roadmap: validated but not yet enforced (see #79).

require_where.description: Roadmap: validated but not yet enforced (see #79).

ff_only.description: Roadmap: validated but not yet enforced (see #79). Fast-forward-only updates are always enforced by the pre-receive hook regardless of this field.

journals_ref_prefix.description: Reserved; not yet honored. Journal refs derive from SHIPLOG_REF_ROOT / git config shiplog.refRoot. Accepted for forward compatibility only.

anchors_ref_prefix.description: Reserved; not yet honored. Anchor refs derive from SHIPLOG_REF_ROOT / git config shiplog.refRoot. Accepted for forward compatibility only.
